remarks: Welcome to 30611 Portside Place, a beautifully reimagined home tucked away on a quiet cul-de-sac in Agoura Hills. Offering 3 bedrooms, 2.5 bathrooms, and 2,115 square feet of living space, this home has been extensively renovated with thoughtful upgrades throughout. The completely remodeled kitchen features all new appliances and offers a fresh, modern feel, while all bathrooms have been updated, including a beautifully renovated primary bathroom. Newer flooring, baseboards, staircase, banister, and interior paint bring everything together, giving the home a clean, cohesive look.
